title: Integral lattice generators and their reduction predicates
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$. Let $X$ be a scheme on its pro-etale site and let $E$ be a finite subextension of a fixed algebraic closure of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, with coefficient objects pulled back from the point [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], [sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed]. The three coefficient objects are the continuous integral, $E$-valued and algebraic-closure-valued ring objects. For a locally closed immersion written as an open immersion followed by a closed immersion, $a_!L_0$ is closed direct image after open extension by zero [sk-def-sfb-module-lower-shriek]. Using scalar extension [sk-def-sfb-change-of-scalars] and the derived categories [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories], define $\mathcal G_E$ to be the degree-zero objects $E_X\otimes_{\mathcal O_{E,X}}a_!L_0$ for locally free finite-rank integral coefficient modules $L_0$, and define $\mathcal G_{\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell,E}$ by further scalar extension to the algebraic closure. For a uniformizer $\pi$, the reduction map at a positive exponent $n$ is the canonical quotient modulo $\pi^n$. Intrinsic realization of finite discrete continuous coefficients is the section-module equivalence, restriction to constant scalars and intrinsic finite-coefficient realization [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. Define the reduction-origin predicate for $a,L_0$ to mean that $a_!L_0$ is bounded constructible [sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible], and for every $n\geq1$ its derived reduction is isomorphic to the degree-zero $a_!$ of the reduced lattice, is bounded constructible, and lies in the essential image of bounded constructible etale complexes under the canonical etale-to-pro-etale comparison [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism].

    [Fact ℓ.Prime] (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ)
    (π : PadicAlgCl.integers ℓ E.1)
    {S V : Scheme.{u}} (u : S ⟶ V) (i : V ⟶ X)
    [IsOpenImmersion u] [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (L₀ : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology S) Ab.{u + 1})
      (integralCoefficientObject S ℓ E)) : Prop
